reason: A pre-training sanity evaluation on the sealed selection banks showed that the original guaranteed nonzero cyclic shift was adversarial rather than null: it drove selection below random because it systematically moved supported-answer rewards onto other candidates. A matched control should make reward assignment independent, not deliberately wrong.

change.new_transformation: Deterministic uniform random permutation over all K! trajectory assignments, SHA256-seeded by run seed, optimizer global step, group index, and prompt hash
change.interpretation: Reward assignment is independent of trajectory quality in expectation. Identity and partial fixed-point permutations are allowed at their correct null probabilities, avoiding a constructed anti-reward.

posthoc_selection_sanity.role: Control validation only; not a method gate

validation: matched-control reward multiset and deterministic-shuffle regression passes
scope: Pre-outcome control-validity correction made before either online arm began. The primary FCE method and every primary gate remain unchanged.
